name: mod.yagens_attributes.galvanized_bone_finger_box

capacity.description: Mod capacity used at level 0 and additional capacity per level. Total capacity cost is base + per_level * level.

max_level_description: Maximum inclusive Mod level. Level 0 is a usable Mod and every entry scales with (level + 1).

entries.description: Fractional additive bonus at level 0. A value of 1.0 means +100%; scales with (level + 1).

Fractional Addition per qualifying target status type or active qualifying-kill stack at level 0. With per_target_status, multiply kill stacks by target status types. The direct_damage stat shares the damage Addition bucket for direct hits and does not increase explosion or status damage. Scales with (level + 1); duration_seconds and max_stacks do not scale with rank.

condition.description: Qualifying kills add a stack, capped at max_stacks. all_at_once refreshes all layers and expires together; one_at_a_time refreshes the next expiry then removes one layer per duration_seconds; independent gives each layer its own expiry and replaces the earliest expiry at capacity. per_target_status multiplies the active kill count by distinct independent target proc types before this hit, ignoring potion effects. Duration and stack cap do not scale with rank.
